episodes.title: The Fall River Cult Murders: Doreen Levesque, Barbara Raposa, Karen Marsden & the Satanic Panic
episodes.description:
The Fall River Cult Murders remain one of Massachusetts true crime’s most disturbing and disputed stories. In 1979 and 1980, Doreen Levesque, Barbara Ann Raposa, and Karen Marsden were killed in and around Fall River. Their deaths became tied to allegations of a Satanic cult, ritual murder, prostitution, drugs, fear, and a witness whose story would later change.
This episode of Under the Pines goes back beneath the cult label to the three young women themselves. Doreen was seventeen and weeks from her eighteenth birthday. Barbara was nineteen and left her infant son with a sitter because she expected to come back. Karen was twenty, wanted her young son back in her life, and disappeared after telling her grandmother she was afraid.
Andre Maltais was convicted of Barbara’s murder. Carl Drew was convicted of Karen’s murder. Robin Murphy pleaded guilty to second-degree murder in Karen’s death and became the key witness linking the cases. She later admitted lying about knowing Doreen and falsely accusing William Smith. No one was convicted of Doreen’s murder. The episode separates what juries decided from disputed ritual claims, recantations, Satanic Panic-era reporting, and the theories that still surround the case.
